doc: Statistics of fbm over 200000 random points, 1 octave(s), billow False: pins the PERLIN3_STD / PERLIN3_ABS_MEAN / PERLIN3_ABS_STD normalization (the output is meant to have unit variance and zero mean). Per seed s = 0..15: 200000 points uniform on the unit sphere (seeded with 100 + s), frequency 40, fbm seed 7000 + s; the outputs are the 16 means and 16 standard deviations. Measured over the 16 seeds: mean +0.0000 (sd over seeds 0.0053), std 1.003 (sd 0.0102). The mean is 0 and the std 1.003 within the spread over seeds. A port draws its own points and tables: its mean and std over 200000 points (one value per run) must lie within params.expect.mean +- k_sigma * mean_sd and std +- k_sigma * std_sd (k_sigma = 4). The Python recompute is compared at rtol 1e-5 + atol 2e-6: float32 variants of the chain (float64, other matmul order, points nudged by one ulp) move a 200000-point mean by 1.3e-7 and the std by 6e-8 at most.
